major_cooldowns.name: Empower Rune Weapon
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Pop it when you are banking two charges so neither is wasted, and use a charge to refill runes and Killing Machine when you are running low.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 47568 is the cast id seen in every sampled parse; 1231100 shares the name and was never cast. The table has no base_cd_s for this row, so the cooldown here is an estimate for a 2-charge ability; verify on Wowhead.

major_cooldowns.name: Pillar of Frost
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it off cooldown, never hold it, and pull Reaper's Mark, Breath of Sindragosa, and Frostwyrm's Fury into the same window.

major_cooldowns.name: Reaper's Mark
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it on cooldown, ideally on the same GCD as Pillar of Frost, and never onto a target that already carries the mark.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 439843 is the cast id; 434765, 436304, and 439594 share the name.

major_cooldowns.name: Breath of Sindragosa
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Start it as soon as Pillar of Frost is up so the two overlap, and lean on Frost Strike beforehand instead of letting runic power cap while you pool for it.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 1249658 is the cast and buff seen in every sampled parse; 155166 and 1234304 share the name and were never cast.

major_cooldowns.name: Frostwyrm's Fury
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Never cast it without Pillar of Frost active. As Deathbringer, fire it right after Pillar of Frost and save the recall cast for your best buff overlap during that same Pillar; as Rider of the Apocalypse, fire it as soon as possible after Pillar of Frost so Apocalypse Now's Horsemen ride while your Strength buff is highest.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 279302 is the initial cast seen in every sampled parse; 1265384 is the Chosen of Frostbrood recall cast, also seen in every parse, and 279303 was never observed.

defensives.name: Anti-Magic Shell
defensives.usage_rule: Pop it to absorb an incoming burst of magic damage and convert the absorbed amount into runic power.

defensives.name: Icebound Fortitude
defensives.usage_rule: Press it before a heavy physical hit lands to cut the damage you take.

defensives.name: Death Pact
defensives.usage_rule: Use it to heal yourself for a portion of your missing health when things go wrong.

defensives.name: Lichborne
defensives.usage_rule: Use it to break a fear or charm effect and to leech health back from your own casts while it is up.

defensives.name: Anti-Magic Zone
defensives.usage_rule: Drop it ahead of a scripted magic damage spike so you and anyone standing in it take less.

rules.description: Open with Pillar, Reaper's Mark, Breath, Frostwyrm's Fury
rules.action: Open with Empower Rune Weapon into Pillar of Frost, then Reaper's Mark, Breath of Sindragosa, and Frostwyrm's Fury before falling into your normal priority.

rules.description: Frostwyrm's Fury only inside Pillar of Frost
rules.action: Never cast Frostwyrm's Fury on its own; only send it while Pillar of Frost is active or you waste Chosen of Frostbrood.

rules.description: Breath of Sindragosa only inside Pillar of Frost
rules.action: Hold Breath of Sindragosa until Pillar of Frost goes up so both buffs run together.
Switch your Killing Machine spender to Frostscythe once you have 2 or more targets.

rules.description: Obliterate gives way to Frostscythe at 2+ targets
rules.action: Stop pressing Obliterate for Killing Machine once you have 2 or more targets and use Frostscythe instead.

rules.description: Glacial Advance replaces Frost Strike at 3+ targets
rules.action: Dump runic power with Glacial Advance once you have 3 or more targets; at exactly 2 targets stay on Frost Strike instead.

rules.description: Frost Strike gives way to Glacial Advance at 3+ targets
rules.action: Drop Frost Strike for Glacial Advance once you have 3 or more targets.
